title: Roma Guest House hybrid back-up system
summary: A hybrid solar back-up system complete with PV panels, inverters and lithium batteries, providing continuous and reliable power for a guest house.
scope: Supply of PV modules, inverters and lithium batteries
challenge: Guest accommodation needs uninterrupted power for lighting, refrigeration and comfort, even when grid supply is interrupted.
solution: Donmac delivered a 17.4 kWp solar array with 40.96 kWh of lithium storage on hybrid inverters, so the building runs on solar by day and on stored energy during outages.
outcomes: Continuous power for guests and staff
